content: Dweelà a Nzam anà libör

Ankwen amɛ, twon làn'sà làkwikilà akà baar bàkakyeyà uyɔl naa ba bye anà Dweelà, wɛɛ lasii, ntɔn muyöb naa nkye an'dweelà amà akà ba man'fà akà Nzam, ntɔn aŋangɔɔm a loor mbɔɔn bàkyàpää u mɛɛn.
Apan bɛ lan'yöb Dweelà a Nzam: dweelà lanswà lan'kyey naa Yɛsu Klistɔ kàyi u ndür, nde wà wà Nzam.
Wɛɛ mbuur wanswà afàtɔn mukyey Yɛsu, akà nde Dweelà a Nzam watɛy, wɛɛ dweelà a un'yiiŋ a Klistɔ: bɛ làkyàwem naa nde awà akyer asàyà, anà apanà, nde kàkyàyà itaan u mɛɛn.
Wɛɛ bɛ, baan amɛ, bɛ baan a Nzam, bɛ làkyàwal iböŋ kusà a aŋangɔɔm aban, ntɔn Dweelà awafàsal uboo a bɛ wà wàngwal aŋàsöön dweelà làfàyaal mɛɛn.
Ba bà baar a mɛɛn. Ba sye bàfàtɛn ndaa a mɛɛn, mɛɛn waa màfàwem.
Wɛɛ bi, bi ibà baan a Nzam. Mbuur awà ayöb Nzam, wàmukiweemà. Mbuur mpa awà wà Nzam, kiweemà anki. Apan, bi ban'yöb Dweelà a ndandaa anà dweelà làfàbwiy ndwaŋ.
Nzam wà ukwen
Abun, atɔŋ amɛ, wɛy bi ikwen bi a bi. Ntɔn ukwen bàfàfà akà Nzam, anà mbuur wanswà afàkwen, bun'bör amu Nzam anà nde akyun'kwen.
Wɛɛ, mbuur mpa afàkwen kàyöb anki Nzam, ntɔn Nzam wà ukwen.
Apan, làler, ukwen a Nzam bàfàmɛnà aben uboo a bi: Nzam kàtöm Mwan ande mwɛy mpɛl u mɛɛn, ntɔn bi iwɛl mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a nde.
Le, ukwen ininà: kà bi anki kàkwen Nzam, wɛɛ nde kikwen, waa kàtöm Mwan ande asànaa ibɔɔn ntɔn ndwääl a man'be abi.
Ankwen amɛ, isàkal naa Nzam kikwen abun, bi sye, ikwen bi a bi.
Akà mbuur mwɛy kàtääŋ anki Nzam. Isàkal naa bi ban'kwen bi a bi, Nzam wà amu bi, anà ukwen ande amu bi bàŋàkwo.
Unsà yayi, bi ifàtà imbäl naa bi ibà amu nde, anà nde amu bi: nde kipɛ Dweelà ande.
Anà bi, bi kàkyer un'tääŋ, waa bi ifàtà imbäl naa Taa kàtöm Mwan asànaa Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mɛɛn.
Mbuur wanswà afàtà imbäl naa Yɛsu wà Mwan a Nzam, Nzam wà amu nde, nde wà amu Nzam.
Waa bi, bi ban'yöb anà ban'sà làkwikilà naa Nzam akyikwen. Nzam wà ukwen. Mbuur awà uboo a ukwen wà amu Nzam, anà Nzam wà amu nde.
Undiir uleŋà ukwen aŋàkwo uboo abi, wà naa bi ikäl aŋàyɔl a làkyän kà ilä a nsaŋ. Bi isàkal abwɛy, ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi u mɛɛn mà wà asànaa awà wànde.
Bɔɔmà batɛy uboo a ukwen. Ukwen aŋàkwo bàfàpiy bɔɔmà, ntɔn bɔɔmà bafàyà mpal bàfàdil ntaaŋàmbar. Anà mbur afàman bɔɔmà ukwen ande kà bàŋakwo anki.
Akà bi, bi ikyer afàkwen, ntɔn Nzam kàtwab atikwen.
Isàkal naa mbuur an'tɛn naa: « Mɛ in'kwen Nzam », wɛɛ nde an'yiiŋà un'tɔŋ ande, nde wà mbuur a loor, ntɔn mbuur mpa ukwen un'tɔŋ awà ukàmanà nde, ukwe anki mukwen Nzam mpa ukàmanà nde.
Anà, le nswɛɛŋ ban'kwo bi mukaar akà nde: mbuur awà akwen Nzam, wɛy ukwen sye un'tɔŋ ande.
